title: Zombie
studio_context: Title track of the album released in Nigeria in 1976 and internationally in 1977; its mockery of the army led to the 1977 raid on the Kalakuta Republic.

drum_performances.name: Tony Allen
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Fela's best-known record, driven by Allen at its fastest: a two-bar groove whose second bar mimics a military march.
